evidence.description: The initializer receives accountsProvider explicitly but obtains authentication state directly from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared.
Visit registration directly reads the access token from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared rather than an explicitly supplied authentication dependency.

candidates.explanation: EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider directly depends on the operational authentication singleton for login status, profile information, and access tokens. This service is not supplied through an explicit replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access
